# semaphore_ex_project_ssh_key_policy (Data Source)

Reads a project SSH key policy.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "semaphore_ex_project_ssh_key_policy" "dependencies" {
  project_id = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (Number)

### Read-Only

- `always_ssh_keys` (Attributes List) Always-added SSH key selection. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--always_ssh_keys))
- `default_ssh_keys` (Attributes List) Default SSH key selection. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--default_ssh_keys))
- `id` (Number) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--always_ssh_keys"></a>
### Nested Schema for `always_ssh_keys`

Read-Only:

- `access_key_id` (Number)
- `hosts` (List of String)


<a id="nestedatt--default_ssh_keys"></a>
### Nested Schema for `default_ssh_keys`

Read-Only:

- `access_key_id` (Number)
- `hosts` (List of String)
